experiment: M2R: a new prospective experiment, distinct from M2. M2 remains recorded as failed under its own frozen rule; its result supports this hypothesis only and passes nothing retroactively.
decision: Owner decision relayed 2026-10-30: gate device-local placement on complete-operation latency, with per-phase regressions stated in advance and a separate phase gate for uses that depend on individual phase latency.
mechanism: Per-usage memory placement for Vulkan buffers. Buffers without MapRead/MapWrite usage (GPU-accessed storage, uniform, index, vertex, indirect, and the queue-write upload targets the CPU fills sequentially) prefer DEVICE_LOCAL within HOST_VISIBLE|HOST_COHERENT. On this device that resolves to heap 1, flags 0x7, which is uncached and write-combined. Mappable buffers keep HOST_CACHED, and MapRead keeps the zero-copy map from 7379fd2fe. MapWrite stays cached because Doe's write mapping snapshots current contents into a host shadow and none of these workloads use it.
codeComparison: Counting-layer memory types, one iteration. Doe main: every buffer is heap 0, flags 0xe (cached and snooped). M2R: storage, uniform and upload targets are heap 1, flags 0x7; readback is heap 0, flags 0xe. Dawn d04f88359 (MemoryTypeSelector + BufferVk GetMemoryKindFor): storage and uniform are heap 1, flags 0x1, suballocated; writeBuffer staging is heap 1, flags 0x7; readback is heap 0, flags 0xe. Both put GPU-accessed data in uncached device-local memory and CPU-read data in cached memory.

sampling.inputs: c1 frozen inputs and independent oracles

metric: complete = compileNs + pipelineNs + resourcesNs + sum of every iteration's operation interval + teardownNs (CPU oracle excluded). Ratios are m2r/main per balanced pair; bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, seed 20261029.

acceptance.validity: every process ok and oracle-checked on every iteration; A/A dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median within [0.95,1.05] with CI95 containing 1 on every workload
acceptance.primaryGate: complete CI95 upper < 1.0 on all three workloads
acceptance.statedPhaseAllowances: accepted in advance: warm.upload median ratio <= 1.15 and resourcesNs median ratio <= 1.15 on each workload (host writes into write-combined memory). Every other warm phase, first.operation, setupNs, compileNs, pipelineNs and teardownNs must have ratio CI95 lower <= 1.05.
acceptance.uploadLatencyPhaseGate: a separate gate for applications that depend on writeBuffer latency itself: warm.upload CI95 upper <= 1.02 on all three workloads. It is recorded and reported separately. Failing it does not change the primary verdict, but the change must not be described as neutral for upload-latency-bound uses.
acceptance.verdict: primary pass only if validity, primaryGate and statedPhaseAllowances all hold
